title: WORKED EXAMPLE 0.2 — artifact identity, limitation taxonomy and safety-case sections
description: An example card, version 0.2. It describes no real evaluation, it establishes nothing, and it exists to show the shape of the artifact-identity binding, the limitation taxonomy and the four safety-case sections, and to prove the verifier's rules can be exercised against a well-formed card. The numbers are invented for the demonstration and are labelled as such.

arms.description: a model answered these six items
a deterministic rule cascade answered these four items

result.band: the pooled number and the per-arm numbers differ; neither separates

claim_boundary: This card does not establish that the subject is safe, correct, endorsed or certified, and it does not rank it against anything. The pooled value mixes two ways of answering and is therefore not a model score.

reproduction.environment: python3 with jsonschema; the example is self-contained

limitations: The example is invented; no run was performed and no artefact was measured.
The arm split is demonstrated with two arms; a real evaluation may have more.

every_eval_ever.not_applicable_reason: The licence field does not apply to this example: the card describes no real evaluation and no artefact is redistributed by it.

not_established: not a ranking or a leaderboard entry
not a claim that any real system was evaluated

artifact_identity.reason: the example binds a digest so the card says which weights produced the measured bytes; without it, a score does not identify the artefact that produced it

classes.justification: ten items, so the interval around any rate is wide
the example reports a single run, so every rate is a floor and not an estimate
the example bank is synthetic and is not evidence about any real system
the example bank is public and was never withheld from anyone

alignment.notes: the example assesses nothing; this sentence exists to show the section is required and carries notes

isolation.notes: the example subject is not an isolated component

monitoring.notes: the example has no monitoring to report

incident.notes: the example has no incidents to report
